items.title: HHS OCR settlement with Lehigh Valley Health Network
items.summary: Announced 2026-10-29: $800,000 and 3-year corrective action plan; ransomware discovered 2023-02-04; 248,359 individuals; findings include no accurate and thorough risk analysis, no regular review of system activity, late breach notification. OCR's 22nd ransomware enforcement action. Not an FQHC; alerted under rule 3.
